 Follow VisionQuest Fans Are Sure Scarlet Witch Is Showing Up in MCU Show’s Finale After New Tease
 Anuraag Chatterjee Tue, November 10, 2026 at 8:55 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Credits: Marvel Studios Marvel Studios has shared a cryptic message ahead of VisionQuest 's finale. The post, published on X, is a sentence written in binary. Upon being decoded, the message is seemingly a quote from WandaVision .
 It is a line uttered by Wanda, where she says, "We could never truly leave each other, even if we tried." The dialogue comes from the season finale, right as Wanda is about to remove her hex over Westview, which would unmake Vision, Tommy, and Billy.
 Fans are convinced that the post might be pointing towards the Scarlet Witch 's appearance in VisionQuest's finale. Given that Wanda is considered deceased after the events of Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, her return would be a major revelation ahead of Avengers: Doomsday, which hits theaters next month.
 Why Marvel fans think Scarlet Witch could appear in the VisionQuest finale?
 Marvel has not confirmed whether The Scarlet Witch will return in the MCU. Elizabeth Olsen, who plays Wanda Maximoff, is not listed as a cast member in the show. However, the official Marvel Studios account posting the hidden message has fueled speculation about what might await fans in the finale.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In the scene where Wanda says this, she is sitting next to Vision and putting Billy and Tommy to bed. Since Billy has already been "resurrected" as Billy Kaplan (introduced in Agatha All Along), the framing of this scene has fueled speculation that not only Wanda, but also Billy will appear in the show's finale.
 VisionQuest will serve as the final chapter of a trilogy that started with WandaVision. Agatha All Along served as the middle chapter of the trilogy. Between WandaVision and Agatha All Along, Wanda Maximoff perished after realizing the error of her ways. Fans have speculated that she might be alive, or in stasis, but characters in-universe have referred to her as being dead.
 VisionQuest's final episode will air on November 10 at 6:00 p.m. PT / 9:00 p.m. ET on Disney+.
